items.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
items.englishText: Glory and praise be to Allah.

items.text: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
items.englishText: I seek Allah’s forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance.

items.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
items.englishText: Glory and praise be to Allah, the Magnificent.

items.text: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ.
items.englishText: There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

items.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ. لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ.
items.englishText: All praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah.

items.text: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ.
items.englishText: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed.

items.text: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي، لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا.
items.englishText: Allah, Allah is my Lord. I associate nothing with Him.

items.text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ.
items.englishText: O Allah, bless our Prophet Muhammad and grant him peace.

items.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ.
items.englishText: Glory and praise be to Allah. Glory be to Allah, the Magnificent.

items.text: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ.
items.englishText: I seek refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil of what He has created.

items.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ.
items.englishText: There is no god but You. Glory be to You. I have been among the wrongdoers.

items.text: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ.
items.englishText: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. You are the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful.

items.text: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا.
items.englishText: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad as my Prophet.

items.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي.
items.englishText: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being, and provide for me.

items.text: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ.
items.englishText: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful instead of what You have forbidden, and enrich me by Your grace so I need no one besides You.

items.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ.
items.englishText: Glory be to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah. Allah is the Greatest.

items.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا.
items.englishText: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, wholesome provision, and deeds that You accept.

items.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ.
items.englishText: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, Possessor of majesty and honor.

items.text: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ.
items.englishText: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him. In Him I trust, and He is Lord of the mighty Throne.

items.text: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا.
items.englishText: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy. You make difficulty easy when You will.

items.text: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ، وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
items.englishText: I seek forgiveness from Allah, the Magnificent, besides whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I turn to Him in repentance.

items.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ.
items.englishText: Glory and praise be to Allah, as many as His creation, to His satisfaction, equal to the weight of His Throne, and the ink of His words.

items.text: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ.
items.englishText: Glory and praise be to You, O Allah. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
